name: Algo Four XL
notes: DX100 panel; one OP picker selects all fourteen operator controls. POLY/MONO is voice count (8/1): Selectors cannot set it. LFO SPEED covers 0.0008–55 Hz. AR/D1R/D2R use 0..31 rates: zero stops the stage; D2R zero holds D1L. D1L/RR use 0..15. Rate scaling uses 0..3. PB MODE selects LOW/HIGH/KON. Breath uses CC 2; foot uses CC 64. Ratio uses semitones, detune cents, bend octaves. Cartridge, MIDI settings and stored patch memory are hardware/storage, not reproduced.
